named_beneficiary.support: "סיעות הקואליציה וסיעות האופוזיציה, כל אחת בנפרד" choose the public representatives; roles are defined by coalition and opposition in general, and no officeholder is named.
named_beneficiary.note: Coded from the Knesset's summary of the law as passed, not the gazette text or the explanatory notes. The deadlock mechanism applies once in each Knesset and to whichever factions form the coalition.

coalition_only.support: Vote 43884, 27 Mar 2025 07:36, roll call: 67 for, 1 against (Miki Levy, Yesh Atid), 2 present not voting (Walid Alhwashla, Ra'am; Merav Michaeli, Labor).
coalition_only.note: For, by faction on the day: Likud 32, Shas 11, Otzma Yehudit 7, UTJ 6, Religious Zionism 6, HaYamin HaMamlachti 4, Noam 1 (Avi Maoz). Six of these factions had members in Government-37 offices on 27 Mar 2025, so they were coalition. Noam is the open case: KNS_PersonToPosition shows Maoz's deputy-minister post in the Prime Minister's Office ending 2025-03-26, the day before the vote, and no reachable Knesset record says whether Noam was then an opposition faction (KNS_Faction has no coalition field). Yes if Noam counts as coalition, No if as opposition. No vote for came from Yesh Atid, National Unity, Yisrael Beytenu, Labor, Ra'am or Hadash-Ta'al.

expedited.support: First reading: vote 38298, 20 Feb 2023. Final: vote 43884, 27 Mar 2025. Interval: 766 days.
expedited.note: The first-reading vote carries the bill's earlier title, 'חוק-יסוד: השפיטה (תיקון מס' 3) (חיזוק הפרדת הרשויות)', under the same bill ID (KNS_BillName). A committee bill, so no preliminary reading. KNS_BillSplit is empty; no record of a special procedure shortening the committee stage. Committee protocols not checked.

scope.support: Supreme Court selection needs five members "הכולל אחד מנציגי הקואליציה ואחד מנציגי האופוזיציה... אך ללא צורך בהסכמת אחד השופטים"
scope.note: The law removes the Bar Association's two seats, which go to jurists chosen separately by coalition and opposition; drops the requirement that a judge concur in Supreme Court appointments; and adds a once-per-Knesset deadlock route. That weakens the judicial check, but the law puts other mechanisms in its place (required opposition concurrence, limits on the deadlock route, a quorum of five, special rules if the coalition exceeds 80 MKs, no selection in an election period), so it does not remove the check with no alternative. Interpretive; based on the summary.

temporary_provision.note: A permanent direct amendment to Basic Law: The Judiciary.

targets_judiciary.support: "בהרכב הוועדה לבחירת שופטים, במקום שני נציגי לשכת עורכי הדין, יבחרו סיעות הקואליציה וסיעות האופוזיציה"

deviation_tier.support: Deadlock mechanism lets coalition representatives "להציע שלושה מועמדים מטעמם ומחייב את יתר החברים לבחור מהם מועמד"
deviation_tier.note: Values engaged: an independent judiciary (principal) and separation of powers. Contradicts judicial independence by removing the judges' required concurrence for Supreme Court appointments, replacing the Bar seats with politically chosen jurists, and the coalition deadlock route. Limited, not sharp: opposition concurrence required, the deadlock route runs once per Knesset and only after a year with two vacancies, a parallel opposition route exists, and the coalition does not get a majority of seats alone. Interpretive.

direction.support: Supreme Court appointment by five members "אך ללא צורך בהסכמת אחד השופטים החברים בוועדה"
direction.note: Axis: judicial independence; weight in selection moves from judges and the Bar toward elected politicians. The opposition-concurrence requirement countervails but does not change the principal direction.
